responsibility: Serves as the master declarative table of C-SKY architectures, core variants, and FPU variants from which the backend derives enums, option tables, and feature mappings. Through macro re-inclusion it describes each public -march, -mcpu, and -mfpu name, associates cores with architectural base versions and tuning identifiers, and attaches inherited ISA feature sets such as DSP or FP capabilities that the rest of the backend tests during option parsing and instruction selection.
